newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's KEL seen strong on trading debut.
newsitem.headline: HK's KEL seen strong on trading debut.

text.p: Shares of electrical and mechanical engineering services concern KEL Holdings Ltd are expected to post strong gains when they make their trading debut on Thursday, analysts said on Tuesday.
"Strong subscription of over 170 times indicated the issue was well received by the market and that will aid sentiment on debut," said Pamela Lam, analyst at Pacific Challenge Securities.
KEL, a spinoff of marine engineering group UDL Holdings Ltd, issued 100 million new shares at HK$1.00 each in its initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong.
"We expect it to have a 50 to 60 percent return in view of the grey market price," said Ben Kwong, director of research at Dharmala Securities. "KEL is also seen sound in fundamentals."
Analysts said the shares had a grey market price of about HK$1.50.
KEL is engaged in the design, supply, installation and maintenance of electrical and mechanical engineering services in the building and construction industry in Hong Kong and China.
